title: Background VoxelGI draws on top of foreground transparent geometry
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.6.1.stable.mono.official [14d19694e] ### System information Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9597) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.91 GiB memory ### Issue description When looking at a voxel gi, while being outside of it, any transparent geometry between camera and voxelgi will be overdrawn by voxelgi, despite being in foreground. In this image the interior in background has a voxel gi volume that tightly fits the building interior. The red cube is opaque and is in front of the building entrance. The gray cube is transparent, and is in front of the red cube. Note it's albedo is set with alpha = 1. The transparent cube renders properly on top of the red cube, and on top of the building geometry part that is outside the voxelgi volume (exterior walls) but the voxelgi interior geometry is rendered on top of it. When VoxelGI is extended to enclose the cubes, the issue disapears and the transparent cube is rendered properly (with alpha == 1) ***Note: This also happens with opaque geometry whose shader reads screen depth/normals (using `hint_depth_texture`)*** ### Steps to reproduce Issue appears in editor and at runtime, when looking at the building entrance, with the transparent cube in front of it. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test-voxel-gi.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28710914/test-voxel-gi.zip)
